description: This PHP source file defines the PasswordEnforceException class within the OrangeHRM authentication exception namespace. It extends a base AuthenticationException and implements redirectable behavior, providing mechanisms to generate a reset code for weak passwords and to produce a redirect URL.

classes.name: PasswordEnforceException
classes.description: A specialized exception class indicating password enforcement issues, particularly used for handling cases involving weak passwords and providing a reset workflow with redirect URL generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a name and message, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: generateResetCode
methods.description: Generates a reset code by logging a password enforce request via the password strength service.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user for changing a weak password, embedding the generated reset code.
